name: LitTwo Crystal Optimizer
description:
LitTwo Crystal Optimizer makes End Crystal placement faster and smoother. It improves crystal usage during combat by optimizing placement speed and making crystal interactions more responsive.

Features:
- Faster End Crystal placement
- Adjustable crystal placement speed
- Optimized crystal placement behavior
- Improved combat responsiveness
- Customizable toggle and speed keybinds

Status: Beta (Work in Progress)
